faq.q: Which boat is faster: Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 is significantly faster, with a top speed around 38 knots thanks to its sportier hull and more powerful engines. The Astondoa 40 cruises at about 25-28 knots. If speed and adrenaline are your priority, go with the Pershing 46.

faq.q: How many people can the Pershing 46 hold?
faq.a: The Pershing 46 can accommodate up to 10 passengers, while the Astondoa 40 holds up to 9. Both are great for small groups or families, but the Pershing has one extra seat.

faq.q: What is the price difference between Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 has fixed rates: €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Pershing 46 pricing is on request via WhatsApp, as it is a higher-performance vessel. Expect the Pershing to be more expensive per hour.

faq.q: Which boat has more deck space?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 offers a larger flybridge and more open deck area, making it better for lounging and sunbathing. The Pershing 46 has a sportier, lower profile with less shaded space but a more dynamic layout.

faq.q: Can I charter both boats from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Yes, both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús in Marbella. This makes them convenient for cruising along the Golden Mile, Cabopino, or even down to Estepona.

faq.q: Which boat is better for a party or celebration?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40, with its spacious flybridge and open layout, is ideal for parties. The Pershing 46 is more about speed and style, better for a small, energetic group wanting a thrill ride.

faq.q: What is included in the Astondoa 40 charter?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Pershing 46 charter also includes these, but confirm specifics via WhatsApp.

data.body_html:
Choosing between a Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40 in Marbella can be tough: both are premium motor yachts departing from Puerto Banús, but they cater to different vibes. The Pershing 46 is a 14-metre sport yacht built for speed and sleek lines, while the Astondoa 40 is a 12.5-metre flybridge cruiser offering more space and a relaxed all-inclusive package. This guide breaks down performance, layout, capacity, and cost to help you decide which boat suits your day on the Costa del Sol.

Size and capacity: Pershing 46 vs Astondoa 40

The Pershing 46 measures 14 metres in length and can carry up to 10 passengers. The Astondoa 40 is slightly shorter at 12.5 metres but still accommodates 9 guests. Both are ideal for small groups, families, or a few friends. If you need that one extra seat, the Pershing edges ahead. However, the Astondoa’s flybridge gives it a more open feel, especially for lounging.

Performance and speed: which is faster?

Speed is the Pershing 46’s headline. With twin engines pushing around 38 knots top speed, it’s a proper performance yacht. The Astondoa 40 cruises comfortably at 25-28 knots — fast enough for a spirited day out, but not in the same league. If you want to feel the wind in your hair and cover more coastline, the Pershing wins. For a leisurely cruise with stops for swimming, the Astondoa is more than adequate.

Deck layout and comfort

The Astondoa 40’s flybridge is its trump card: an upper deck with seating, a sun pad, and a bimini for shade. The main deck also has a spacious cockpit and bow sunbathing area. The Pershing 46 has a sportier, lower profile with a large aft sun pad and a compact but stylish interior. The Astondoa is better for sunbathing and socialising; the Pershing is more about the driving experience.

Pricing: what you’ll pay

The Astondoa 40 has clear, all-inclusive pricing: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Pershing 46 is priced on request via WhatsApp — expect a premium for its performance and brand cachet. For a fixed budget, the Astondoa offers great value. For a high-speed luxury experience, the Pershing is the upgrade.

Which boat is better for your Marbella charter?

Pick the Pershing 46 if you want speed, style, and a sportier feel — ideal for a shorter, adrenaline-filled trip. Pick the Astondoa 40 if you value space, a flybridge, and a relaxed all-inclusive day. Both depart from Puerto Banús, so you can explore the Marbella coastline, stop at Boat Rental Marbella for more options, or head to Cabopino for lunch. For a party, the Astondoa’s flybridge is hard to beat. For a thrill, the Pershing is your boat.

Which boat is faster: Pershing 46 or Astondoa 40?

The Pershing 46 is significantly faster, with a top speed around 38 knots thanks to its sportier hull and more powerful engines. The Astondoa 40 cruises at about 25-28 knots. If speed and adrenaline are your priority, go with the Pershing 46.

The Pershing 46 can accommodate up to 10 passengers, while the Astondoa 40 holds up to 9. Both are great for small groups or families, but the Pershing has one extra seat.

The Astondoa 40 has fixed rates: €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Pershing 46 pricing is on request via WhatsApp, as it is a higher-performance vessel. Expect the Pershing to be more expensive per hour.

Which boat has more deck space?

The Astondoa 40 offers a larger flybridge and more open deck area, making it better for lounging and sunbathing. The Pershing 46 has a sportier, lower profile with less shaded space but a more dynamic layout.

Can I charter both boats from Puerto Banús?

Yes, both the Pershing 46 and Astondoa 40 depart from Puerto Banús in Marbella. This makes them convenient for cruising along the Golden Mile, Cabopino, or even down to Estepona.

The Astondoa 40, with its spacious flybridge and open layout, is ideal for parties. The Pershing 46 is more about speed and style, better for a small, energetic group wanting a thrill ride.

The Astondoa 40 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The Pershing 46 charter also includes these, but confirm specifics via WhatsApp.
